TypeAstra – Free Typing Tutor, Typing Speed Test & Typing Game

TypeAstra (formerly Typing Master) is a free online typing tutor. Learn touch typing from zero to professional, check your typing speed in words per minute (WPM) and improve your accuracy with finger placement lessons, random drills, real English paragraphs and programming text. It runs in your browser with no sign-up.

TypeAstra एक मुफ़्त ऑनलाइन टाइपिंग ट्यूटर है। टाइपिंग सीखें, अपनी टाइपिंग स्पीड (WPM) और सटीकता जाँचें और टाइपिंग गेम खेलें।

Typing practice and typing speed test

  • 16 levels with 75 typing rounds: finger guide, home row, combinations, random drills and mixed reviews
  • Typing speed (WPM) and accuracy shown after every round, with progress history
  • Practise key typing with real English paragraphs and programming text
  • Practise with your own text or files (PDF, Word, TXT) in My Text

Flappy Typing – a typing game

Level 16 is Flappy Typing, a Flappy Bird-style typing game. Type letters in round 1, words in round 2 and sentences in round 3. A correct key flies the bird through the gap and a wrong key makes it crash.

More features

  • Finger guide with an on-screen keyboard
  • Music and style shop with coins and stars
  • Dark and light themes
  • Your data stays on your own device, with no login

Frequently asked questions

Is TypeAstra a free typing tutor?

Yes. TypeAstra is free to use in your browser, with no sign-up or login.

How can I test my typing speed (WPM)?

Practise any round in TypeAstra and it shows your typing speed in words per minute (WPM) and your accuracy at the end. Your history is saved on your own device.

How do I learn touch typing with TypeAstra?

Follow the 16-level course. It starts with the finger guide and home row, then moves through combinations, random drills, mixed reviews and a typing game. There are 75 typing rounds in total.

What is the Flappy Typing game?

Flappy Typing is a Flappy Bird-style typing game in Level 16. Type the right letters, words and sentences to fly the bird through the gaps; a wrong key makes it crash.

Is TypeAstra the same as Typing Master?

TypeAstra was formerly called Typing Master. It is now a free online typing tutor that runs in the browser.

Can I practise typing with my own text or files?

Yes. Use My Text to add your own text or a PDF, Word or TXT file and practise typing it.
